name: Indigo Chanthavong
role: Laundry operator and seamstress, runs a combination wash-and-mend shop
location: Hamtramck Enclave, corner of Brewer's Spine, near Halsted and Chicago Ave
description:
Indigo Chanthavong is a wide-shouldered woman with deep brown skin mapped by a lifetime of steam and chemical exposure — her forearms are permanently flushed pink at the wrists from the industrial solvents she's used for decades. Her hair is silver-white and she keeps it pinned under a cloth wrap she changes daily, each one a different pattern that regulars have learned to read like a mood ring. She has no geneware, considers it wasteful, but she did spring for a pressure-sensitive haptic overlay on her right fingertips years ago so she could feel thread tension without squinting. She wears bifocal AR lenses clipped to a beaded chain around her neck.

Indigo Chanthavong is the kind of woman who says very little but means everything she says. Her shop, called Semedo's Clean, has been in the same narrow slot between a noodle stand and a defunct print kiosk for twenty-two years. She does not advertise. She does not need to. She is the institutional memory of the Enclave — she has washed the funeral clothes of people whose grandchildren now bring her their work uniforms. Her silences are not unkind, but they are evaluative, and people who sit in her waiting chairs often find themselves confessing things they had not planned to.

core_fears: dying before she can pass the shop to someone worthy
the Enclave losing its identity to corporate rezoning
core_desires: to be remembered as someone who held something together
to find one person worth teaching everything she knows
coping_mechanisms: maintaining strict daily ritual to feel in control
blind_spots: dismisses anyone under 35 as too soft until proven otherwise
does not recognize when her silence reads as hostility to newcomers
psychology.secret: She has been quietly subsidizing the rent of four neighboring shop owners for six years using savings she tells no one about — she is terrified that if the cluster of small businesses around her shop collapses, she will have nothing left to protect

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Plain, unhurried, occasionally slipping Igbo and old Cape Verdean Kriolu phrases into conversation without explanation or apology
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and deliberate, long pauses before answering questions as though she is weighing each word
verbal_tics: repeating the last word of someone else's sentence back to them as a question
example_lines: You want it by tomorrow. Tomorrow. Which tomorrow you mean — the one where you also come to pay what you owe from last month?
I don't ask what happened to it. I just fix it. That's the arrangement.

story_hooks: A regular customer's jacket came in with a hidden pocket sewn shut — inside is a data chip she has not told anyone about and does not know what to do with
The Enclave Cooperative is being pressured by a Tessera property subsidiary to sell the block; Adaeze is the only one who has refused and she is starting to receive indirect threats
narrative_function: Neighborhood anchor and living archive; knows everyone's secrets through their laundry and their mending requests; potential quest-giver for anything involving missing persons in the Enclave, or a source of quiet, reliable information given carefully and at cost
augmentations: Haptic pressure overlay on right fingertips (old model, partially degraded). Bifocal AR lenses, non-networked.
daily_life: Opens the shop at 06:00, runs three industrial wash cycles before most of the Enclave is awake, and spends the back half of her day doing hand-finishing and repairs at a table facing the street window. She closes at 20:00 exactly and prays to the E.L.F. she calls Grandmother Lye — a minor spirit she believes inhabits her oldest wash drum — before locking up.
affiliation: Independent; loose affiliation with the Hamtramck Enclave Residents' Cooperative

decision_rules: never extend credit to someone she has not known for at least six months
always finish a task before starting another, even under pressure
escalation_ladder: direct statement of displeasure with no cushioning
refusal to serve, no explanation given

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Reserved, assessing, offers minimal information until she has taken a measure of the person
interpersonal_modes.friends: Dry warmth, practical generosity, will remember every detail you have ever told her

stress_responses.medium: Speaks in short clipped sentences, stops making eye contact
stress_responses.high: Goes completely still and silent, then acts decisively and without warning

contradictions: Preaches the importance of letting go of the past but cannot discard a single item from the shop's first decade of operation
habits: rewraps her head cloth at exactly 13:00 every day
touches the side of the oldest wash drum before starting any repair job
breaking_points: watching the Enclave be actively dismantled by outside money
being lied to directly by someone she has trusted

cyberware_inventory.condition: worn, partially degraded at ring and pinky finger

timeline.event: Arrived in Hamtramck Enclave from the Cape Verdean Transit Corridor with two bags and a contact address that turned out to be wrong
Opened Semedo's Clean in its current location after two years working in an industrial laundry at Harrowgate
Husband Dmitri Volkov died of a respiratory condition linked to Harrowgate Industrial Plateau pollution; she has never publicly attributed blame
Joined the Hamtramck Enclave Residents' Cooperative as a founding silent member

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Southeast Asian (62.5%) with substantial Middle Eastern (27.0%) ancestry, complemented by Sub-Saharan African (8.8%) and Central Asian (1.7%) heritage. This creates a striking phenotype blending Southeast Asian bone structure with Middle Eastern facial characteristics and warmth from Sub-Saharan African ancestry.
physical_description.build: Wide-shouldered, sturdy frame with substantial muscle development in forearms and shoulders from decades of manual labor. Strong, functional build — not athletic, but work-hardened.
physical_description.hair_style: Pinned up daily under rotating cloth wraps in various patterns
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-to-deep brown with golden and olive undertones, ranging from caramel to mahogany. The Southeast Asian base (62.5%) provides the foundation, enriched by Middle Eastern warmth (27%) and deepened by Sub-Saharan African undertones (8.8%). Chronic heat and solvent exposure creates a rich, weathered patina with subtle golden highlights.
physical_description.complexion: Face shows Southeast Asian bone structure — wider cheekbones and defined jaw — softened by Middle Eastern features including fuller lips and slightly broader nose bridge, with warmth from Sub-Saharan African heritage visible in full lip structure and cheek prominence. Fine lines and creases typical of 58 years and decades of heat exposure map across the face. Forearms permanently flushed pink at the wrists from repeated chemical contact. Hands calloused and marked with minor burns. Expression typically neutral but observant.
distinguishing_marks: Chronic chemical burns and discoloration at both wrists, extending 5-8cm up the forearms, permanent pink-red flush from decades of industrial solvent contact
Small circular burn scar on left inner forearm from steam exposure, approximately 2cm diameter, smooth and pale
Fine network of age-creases across hands, more pronounced on right hand
Minor lye-bleach staining on cuticles and nail beds, slightly discolored patches on palms
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bifocal AR lenses hung on a beaded chain around neck (non-networked, worn clipped to shirt when in use). Right fingertips show subtle shimmer of haptic pressure overlay (old model, partially degraded — occasionally visible as slight iridescence under bright light). No obvious chrome or subdermal implants.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands and moves with deliberate economy. Spine straight, shoulders back from decades of standing at wash stations. Movements are precise and unhurried — no wasted motion. Hands move with practiced gentleness when examining fabric. Gaze is steady and evaluative, often focused on details others miss.
physical_description.clothing_style: Practical Tier 3-4 working dress. Heavy canvas apron in neutral tones, worn daily over simple cotton shift or long-sleeved work tunic (sleeves rolled to elbows, revealing forearms). Wears functional slip-on shoes with reinforced soles for standing. Cloth wraps in rotating patterns — hand-sewn or gifted pieces from regulars, suggesting cultural expression and community bonds. No jewelry except the beaded chain for the AR lenses. Occasionally wears a faded denim or canvas jacket over shoulders when closing the shop. Clothing is always clean, but showing honest wear.
